detail: Scholarships are budgeted at $181,500 a year for 11 scholars, $16,500 each. NSF 25-514: "The established maximum amount of an individual scholarship is $15,000 per year for undergraduate students".
F&A is charged on the scholarships. They are participant support (budget line F1), which is excluded from the MTDC base.
Draft describes Hispanic enrolment as 31%; the registrar's fall 2026 census records 26.4%.
S-STEM requires an evaluation plan "executed by an external evaluator"; the plan and budget put the evaluation in the university's own Office of Institutional Research.
